messages:
amy-sales: Hey team, urgent — live POC with FinSolve hitting 503s during a demo. They're seeing repeated 503 CapacityThrottle errors and the demo is blocked. Can ops triage? :grimacing:
marcus-support: Ugh. Which endpoint and model? Any request patterns?
amy-sales: Using /v1/generate chat on hosted RedAPI, model=redwood-2-xl, bursty demo traffic ~30 concurrent connections for 90s. Root ts 1934023400 in their logs.
jamal-eng: Sounds like burstpool/backlog kicked in. Can you share the exact error payload?
amy-sales: Pasting customer log snippet here:
```
{"error":"503","message":"CapacityThrottle: backlog depth=27, queue_ms=1200, autoscale_state=delayed"}
```
marcus-support: That message matches our throttle path — autoscaler lag + backlog. Did they hit rate limits too?
amy-sales: They said no 429s, only 503s. They tried retrying a few times.
jamal-eng: If no 429s it's autoscale inability to provision GPUs fast enough for the burst. We default to keep latency SLOs so we return 503s instead of degrading. We have two immediate options: temporary increase dedicated burst pool for the account OR advise client to client-side rate limit/retry with jitter.
eli-security: Also got a note from their security team asking whether Private (VPC) deployment is an option for the POC — they want to run through the questionnaire while we triage. We should coordinate answers and any implications for capacity.
nora-prod: @jamal-eng, can we trigger a manual scale/evict and warm up a smaller variant (redwood-2-large-quant) as fallback? That would reduce capacity pressure but may change outputs.
jamal-eng: Yes, we can set an automated fallback to the "compat-quant" variant for this tenant. Action: push config to route traffic to compat-quant when backlog>20. Needs approval from product for customer-facing behavior.
marcus-support: I'm going to DM FinSolve with a safe suggestion: lower concurrency to 8-10 connections, use exponential backoff on retries (start 200ms), and we'll enable canary fallback to compat-quant for them now.
amy-sales: They're on the call, can we do it now? They're worried about demo flow and pricing question re: burst add-on credits.
jamal-eng: I'm flipping the fallback flag now. Will watch logs.
[5m later]
oncall-bot: Deploy action: set-route-fallback tenant=finSolve variant=compat-quant initiated by jamal-eng at 1934023515.
jamal-eng: Fallback in place. Initial metrics: backlog dropped from 27 -> 6, 503s stopped. Latency increased ~120ms on tail.
amy-sales: They're back on the demo and it's working. Seller asks about compensatory credits — sales decides.
eli-security: I'll start the security questionnaire answers and note that default hosted has SOC2, TLS, and optional Private deployment info. Ping me with any specifics FinSolve needs.
marcus-support: I'll open an internal follow-up ticket to investigate why autoscaler lagged: collect histogram of scale events, provisioning time, and whether kernel selection caused longer warmup. Ticket created: SR-7932.
jamal-eng: Postmortem plan: gather VM/GPU allocation logs, check if we had concurrent bulk provisioning in the region, add a hard threshold to enable fallback earlier.
amy-sales: Thanks all — pls keep me posted in this thread. FinSolve wants a short note on the workaround and a timeline for permanent fix. I'll handle the customer comms. :thumbsup:
